item.title: 업스
item.description: Operational assisstance Services are continuously in movement, they don’t always move by themselves. Anything from a mission critical cloud service disconnecting to a printer malfunction can be a costly problem. Available in in person(Norther Seoul area), or remotely. All prices displayed are estimates and subject to change. Support services provided by Lazursoft include: Maintaining physical devices (northern Seoul/Uijeongbu only): Promise to answer on call and troubleshoot devices Monthly remote check in: a monthly check using remote desktop control.
